newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Top Geneva private bank to manage Polish funds.
newsitem.headline: Top Geneva private bank to manage Polish funds.

text.p: Switzerland's leading private bank Pictet & Cie said on Thursday it was launching a new Polish investment fund worth up to $50 million jointly with Poland's Bank Rozowoju Eksportu SA (BRE).

The Geneva-based bank said in a statement the closed-end fund would invest in Polish companies in pre-listing phase on the Warsaw stock exchange, mass privatisation certificates and shares in national investment funds.
The Polish Pre-IPO Fund will be based in Luxembourg. Pictet & Cie also said it was setting up a joint company with BRE to offer institutional fund management services in Poland.
Pictet & Cie, founded in 1805 in Geneva and one of Switzerland's oldest private banks, has more than $50 billion in assets under management.
